summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers, the plot_2d_or_3d_image function, and the refactored segmentation, classification, and TensorBoard image handlers per the spec. Files changed: new monai/data/csv_saver.py and monai/data/nifti_saver.py; monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py (plot function added); monai/data/nifti_writer.py (default dtype np.float32); monai/handlers/segmentation_saver.py, classification_saver.py, tensorboard_handlers.py rewritten as thin adapters; output_path renamed to output_dir in two examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py; test_handler_classification_saver.py updated to pass filename; new tests test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. Verification was by reading only: no line exceeds 120 characters, every changed file ends with exactly one newline, and no unused imports or stale output_path references remain. Tests were NOT run and flake8 was NOT run, because the instructions forbade running repository code. Nothing was committed.
